data.name: Gaia
data.description: Gaia is a Danish joint venture (Gaia ProjectCo P/S) between Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners' Energy Transition Fund (majority) and municipal waste-to-energy operator Vestforbrænding, developing a full-scale amine-based carbon capture retrofit at the Glostrup incineration facility. The project targets up to 500,000 tonnes of CO₂ captured annually from 2029, with the biogenic portion sold as carbon removal credits; Microsoft signed a 2.95 Mt offtake agreement in July 2025.
